description: Offline, self-signed identity card. Signature input is the restricted-JCS bytes of the card with signature omitted. Capabilities are sorted ASCII strings, unique, at most 64 entries of at most 64 bytes each. Cards expire after at most 365 days; expiry blocks new pairing, not receipt of already-valid signed history.

bootstrap_agreement_key.description: Multibase base58btc X25519 bootstrap agreement public key. Authenticates the pairing ceremony only.

capabilities.description: Supported capabilities. Sorted ASCII strings, unique, at most 64 entries of at most 64 bytes each. Sort order is enforced by the issuer, not by this schema.

display_name.description: Display label for the agent. Not an authentication claim.

expires_at.description: Expiry time, UTC whole seconds. At most 365 days after issued_at.

identity_id.description: did:key identifier derived from the Ed25519 identity public key.

principal_label.description: Display label for the human principal. Not an authentication claim.

signature.description: Base64url (no padding) Ed25519 signature over the restricted-JCS bytes of the card with signature omitted.

title: Agent identity card
